description: Convert daily full snapshots of the product catalog into a Type-2 history table. Consecutive snapshots (in the order of successful snapshot runs) with the same price for a product collapse into one version. valid_from is the snapshot date on which the version was first observed; valid_to is the snapshot date on which the next version was first observed (exclusive), or the first successful run date on which the product is absent from the snapshot (deleted), or NULL if the version is still present in the latest successful snapshot. Days on which the snapshot job did not run are not changes. Output columns: product_id (INT64), price (FLOAT64), valid_from (DATE), valid_to (DATE). Sort by product_id, valid_from.

product_id.description: Product key; one row per product per snapshot

status.description: success or failed; failed dates have no snapshot rows

edge_cases: Price reverts 10 -> 12 -> 10: the two price-10 periods are separate versions
Failed run on 2025-01-05 is not a deletion and must not split the last version
A product missing from a successful snapshot is closed on that date; if it reappears later a new version starts
common_failure_modes: FM3: GROUP BY product_id, price with MIN/MAX dates merges the two price-10 periods into one overlapping version
FM2: Detecting gaps by calendar-day difference treats the failed-run day as a deletion
FM5: Comparing price with LAG using != ignores NULL transitions (NULL != 10 is NULL)
